Source programs and outputs were checked at their actual paths; no inference from samples to infinite claims.

value.rationale: The complement of triangular graph T(6), KG(6,2), is the first even-degree two-subset Kneser graph after Petersen, creating genuine incumbent ties. Its exact sharp three-step cutoff, oscillatory basin entrance restricted to t<=1, and five-point basin-size spectrum with complete S6 orbit classes are mathematically motivated natural dynamical invariants of a canonical strongly regular graph. The result is a complete classification on this finite graph, not an arbitrary support slice or a tiny gain in a known table.
